findings.text: follow-on: a foreign run whose liveness is unknown, whose stream is in motion and whose manifest is present-but-unreadable now falls through to the catch-all running arm at :1048, whose detail text at :1052 reads "an in-harness run: liveness belongs to the calling harness" — a sentence written for a local pid-less run that misdescribes a run launched on another node; the classification (running) is correct and matches the deliverable, so this does not hold the node, and the worker recorded it in follow_ons rather than changing it because §10's deliverable names only the hoisted verdict and its tests.
